launches.title: Simple AI - AI phone assistant for consumers
launches.tagline: Simple makes phone calls so you don't have to
launches.body:
**We’re thrilled to announce that starting today, Simple AI Phone Assistant is available on the** [**App Store**](https://www.usesimple.ai/join?inviteCode=launchyc).\
\
Simple AI can make AI powered phone calls on your behalf. Simple can wait on hold and navigate phone trees. Simple can make phone calls in 33 countries using 15 different languages, or even call 10 different stores at the same time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86078&key=user_uploads/195464/3b0d8227-3cb8-443c-a8a4-fc0796c390c9)

We tested a beta version of the app extensively with our initial set of 1000 users. We wanted to make sure Simple could successfully perform a variety of tasks, including: making restaurant reservations; finding and booking doctors, dentist, and vision appointments; asking grocery stores, hardware stores, and other retail stores for availability or stock; calling customer support to ask for help with accounts, billing, and more.\
\
We started Simple AI with the simple vision to bring the power of AI to regular people. We went through YC’s Summer 24 batch. During YC, we saw many startups working on ideas that leverage the new AI and LLM technology to upend various industries. But no one was working on AI for consumers.

It turns out people really hate making phone calls, and our AI is pretty good at it.

In fact, it’s _better_ than a human at certain tasks. Zach and Cat both needed a new eye doctor and independently set out to find one that would 1) take our new insurance, and 2) had availability soon. Zach did some research on the internet and got an appointment 3 weeks out. Cat had Simple call 15 optometrists near Potrero Hill and got hers in 6 days.

We give people access to an AI assistant at their fingertips. Read more about our launch on [our blog](https://usesimple.ai/blog/launch) or try it out today at [https://usesimple.ai/join](https://usesimple.ai/join?inviteCode=launchyc).

### **Team**

[Zach](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zach-kamran/) and [Catheryn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/catherynli/) met at YC, where they spent 4 years building consumer products like Bookface, Startup School, and YC’s co-founder matching site.

launches.title: Simple AI - a better Siri
launches.tagline: Simple AI is what Siri should be. We make it 10x easier for you to use your favorite consumer apps.
launches.body:
[Simple AI](https://www.usesimple.ai/) is what Siri should be. We make it 10x easier for you to use your favorite consumer apps: Amazon, Uber, Doordash, Venmo, Maps, etc. We can also help you do research and book anything from restaurants and flights to that local minigolf place that doesn’t have a website.

The consumer products we use every day are often confusing, adversarial, and sometimes downright deceptive. It makes sense when you realize that Amazon and Google’s primary customers are merchants and advertisers, not you and me.

Our goal is to help you cut through the noise and go from “having an intent” to “getting it done.”

### **Our ask**

If you have an iPhone, try out our mobile app! Please reach out to [founders@usesimple.ai](mailto:founders@usesimple.ai) or join the [waitlist](https://www.usesimple.ai/) and we’ll onboard you soon.
